channel.title: Lynn Group Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lynn Group Media (hoganstand.com)

item.title: 'It appears that we will finally be entering the delivery phase'
item.description: The long-awaited redevelopment of Casement Park is finally set to commence this year.

item.title: UL begin Fitzgibbon Cup defence against Maynooth
item.description: The 2026 Fitzgibbon Cup commences today with two games taking place.

item.title: 'It would have been silly not to ask him in'
item.description: Andy Moran has hailed Kobe McDonald as a 'hyper-talented boy' after including him in his Mayo football squad.

item.title: O'Connor gets green light to play in All-Ireland club final
item.description: Dingle have been handed a huge boost with the news that Mark O'Connor has been granted permission by Geelong to line out in Sunday week's All-Ireland club SFC final against St Brigid's.

item.title: Legendary goalkeeper wins €5k in new Offaly GAA 50/50 draw
item.description: Goalkeeping great Martin Furlong has hit the jackpot by winning €5,000 in Offaly GAA's new 50/50 draw.

item.title: Coin toss decides postponed Conor McGurk Cup fixtures
item.description: Three teams have been eliminated from the Conor McGurk Cup (Ulster hurling pre-season competition) after a coin toss was used to determine the winners of their postponed ties.

item.title: Rebels suffer Corbett blow
item.description: Conor Corbett will miss the early rounds of Cork's Allianz Football League Division 2 with a shoulder injury.

item.title: 2026 Munster U20 and minor championship fixtures confirmed
item.description: The 2026 Munster U20 and minor championship fixtures in hurling and football have been confirmed.

item.title: TJ Reid handed Kilkenny captaincy for a third time
item.description: TJ Reid has been confirmed as Kilkenny senior hurling captain for 2026.

item.title: McFaul out of Derry reckoning as Slaughtneil stars return
item.description: New Derry football boss Ciaran Meenagh is planning without Ciaran McFaul for the 2026 campaign.
